label: Elections Deadline
contestNote: The '4+4' committee formally signed its election deal at UNSMIL headquarters in Tripoli on Aug 30, 2026, committing to elections within 24 months under a single executive authority. The HoR and HSC now have one month to formally approve it, or it becomes a binding constitutional document with UN Security Council backing. Domestic legitimacy questions persist — HoR member al-Daghari said eastern lawmakers were not consulted on the negotiating team, echoing concerns Menfi and al-Malati raised over the Aug 20 Tunis draft — even as Dbeibah, Khalifa Haftar, Saddam Haftar, and Osama Hamad all welcomed the signing.
